text: OVERDOSAGE Doses up to 1000 mg/m 2 /day of Targretin ® capsules have been administered in short-term studies in patients with advanced cancer without acute toxic effects. Single doses of 1500 mg/kg and 720 mg/kg were tolerated without significant toxicity in rats and dogs, respectively. These doses are approximately 30 and 50 times, respectively, the recommended human dose on a mg/m 2 basis. No clinical experience with an overdose of Targretin ® capsules has been reported. Anyoverdose with Targretin ® capsules should be treated with supportive care for the signs and symptoms exhibited by the patient.
